milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task — the player must navigate near the enchanting table and face toward it, demonstrating they have found and are observing it. The enchanting table is at spawn-relative (7, 0, 7) inside a stone brick building with a 2-block-wide entrance at Z=5. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually navigated to the building (reachable from the doorway at ~2 blocks or from inside), rather than just looking in its general direction from spawn (~9.9 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the table. Sandbox verification confirmed the enchanting table exists at (7,0,7) and the agent can reach the doorway within 20 steps.
